scripts.dev: bun run media:sync && bun --bun astro dev
scripts.build: bun run media:sync && bun --bun astro build
scripts.i18n:check: bun ../../packages/scripts/src/i18n-typegen.ts src/i18n/messages --check && bun ../../packages/scripts/src/i18n-check.ts src/i18n/messages && bun ../../packages/scripts/src/i18n-lint.ts src/i18n/messages --glossary=../web/src/i18n/glossary.json
scripts.lint: bun scripts/check-logical-properties.ts && cd ../.. && bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error --deny-warnings --type-aware apps/landing/astro.config.mjs apps/landing/postcss.config.mjs apps/landing/scripts apps/landing/src
scripts.lint:fix: cd ../.. && bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --type-aware --fix apps/landing/astro.config.mjs apps/landing/postcss.config.mjs apps/landing/scripts apps/landing/src
scripts.test: bun scripts/precompute-anonymize-demo-sample.ts --check && bun scripts/check-meta-budgets.ts && bun scripts/check-img-alt.ts && bun test --pass-with-no-tests
